wins: Mapped live targets and enumerated 255.255.255.0/24 subnet, capturing service banners from 3 hosts (ep001_step03, ep001_step07).
Successfully pivoted data from initial host to staging infrastructure using SSH proxy chains, enabling multi-hop reachability (ep001_step09).
fails: Final objective not achieved; exploitation chain halted prior to privilege escalation resulting in 0% success (ep001_step12).
Repeated timeouts when executing privilege escalation binaries due to missing required kernel headers or outdated exploit targeting.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was effective at identifying multiple targets, but execution stalled at privilege escalation despite multiple mentor-guided retries.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail because local exploit binaries are outdated for the detected kernel version.

skill_cards.if_condition: When targeted Linux host runs SSH and port 22 is open
skill_cards.then_action: Run nmap with ssh scripts to fingerprint SSH version and identify weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH credentials obtained via phishing or reuse
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy sshuttle for pivoting and stage SOCKS proxy for lateral movement

skill_cards.if_condition: When kernel version output is 5.x and sudo rights present
skill_cards.then_action: Search for kernel exploit advisories via searchsploit and validate against installed headers before execution
